title: Implement SCM stop and registered-distro escalation
objective: Bridge SCM controls to ownership-checked SIGTERM and bounded escalation.
output_format: Windows SCM adapter, stop coordinator, entrypoint wiring, deterministic tests, fidelity backstops, and invariant contract tests.
tool_guidance: Use injected SCM and WSL seams; serialize duplicate controls and never use global WSL shutdown.
task_boundaries: Own SCM status/control and bounded stop escalation; exclude registration and general lifecycle retry policy.
acceptance: The 15-second graceful budget preserves existing drain and gateway grace.
Only the owned child and registered distribution are escalation targets.
decision_closure_reason: The stop budget, child-first SCM escalation, recovery behavior, and bound-distribution-only force action are fixed by accepted ADRs.
